fact: In May 2025 the state-owned Empresa Nacional de Hidrocarbonetos tendered (Concurso Público 10/GAPO/ENH/071.2/2025) for a disaster-recovery site and a secondary data centre, with VMware Site Recovery Manager linking its main and secondary data centres; the location and distance are not stated.
title: Caderno de Encargos, Concurso Público Nº10/GAPO/ENH/071.2/2025 - Site de Recuperação de Desastres (Site Recovery)
